description: Propose pairs of entities that may be the same thing, so merge_entities can be used on a pair you would not have noticed. With by: "name" the names are compared after case, spacing, punctuation and a known suffix such as .service are normalised, and overlapping observations raise the score; with by: "content" the observations are compared instead, which is how one fact written twice under two names is found. It is read-only. A score is a hint, not a verdict: read both entities before merging them.

by.description: What to compare: name (default) or content

limit.description: The most pairs to return, 20 by default, best first

threshold.description: The lowest score to report, 0.75 by default

name: find_duplicates
title: Find Duplicates
